chunks: And Abu Ja‘far al-Baqir عليه السلام said:
No servant leaves something for the sake of Allah, Mighty and Majestic, and then loses by it.

key_terms.عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ: Mighty and Majestic, an expression of glorification for Allah
key_terms.فَفَقَدَهُ: and then lost it or suffered loss because of it
key_terms.لِلَّهِ: for the sake of Allah alone

ai.seo_question: Does a person ever truly lose by giving up something for the sake of Allah?
ai.summary: Imam Abu Ja‘far al-Baqir عليه السلام teaches that whatever a servant abandons sincerely for Allah عز وجل is never a true loss. The hadith emphasizes trust in Allah and the moral certainty that sacrifice for His sake is ultimately beneficial.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4300 - Abu Ja'far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) said:
"No servant leaves something for the sake of Allah (swt), the Almighty and Glorious, and then finds himself in loss because of it."
